label: Inventory reports
description: A snapshot of out-of-stock and low-stock products and variants.

fields.label: Snapshot taken
fields.description: When stock levels were checked (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Low stock threshold
fields.description: Stock at or below this level counts as low. Set in the app settings.

fields.label: Tracked SKUs
fields.description: Active products and variants with stock tracking turned on.

fields.label: Out of stock
fields.description: Tracked products and variants with no stock left.

fields.label: Low stock
fields.description: Tracked products and variants at or below the low stock threshold, but not out.

fields.label: Needing attention %
fields.description: Share of tracked products and variants that are low or out of stock.

fields.label: Inventory report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this snapshot. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.

rows.label: Out of stock
rows.hint: Tracked products and variants with no stock left.

rows.label: Low stock
rows.hint: Tracked products and variants at or below the low stock threshold, but not out.

fields.label: Items
fields.description: Out-of-stock items first, then the ones that will run out soonest. Up to 50 are listed.

params.empty: No products or variants are out of stock or running low.
params.unlisted_note: {n} more low or out-of-stock items were not listed. Each report lists up to 50.

fields.label: Not listed
fields.description: Low or out-of-stock items not listed, because each report lists up to 50.

fields.label: Partial
fields.description: Yes when the store had more records than one report reads, so the counts are a minimum.
